title: Ratchet flags parsing + durable registry + index-time registration
description:
TOML: per-constraint `ratchet = true` and workspace `[ratchet] all = true` in src/rules.rs (flags are triggers, not state; old-format constraints unaffected). New durable table `constraint_ratchets` (ADR-0002 durable partition): constraint_id, name, rendered_description (human-readable summary of what the constraint was, for post-deletion reporting), severity_floor, registered_at, released_at, released_by, release_rationale. Migration + CRUD in src/db/constraints.rs.

Registration at index time (precedent: external.rs check_workspace_externals is the index-side entry point pattern): every flagged constraint upserts a registry row; severity_floor = monotone max(existing, current); flag/constraint removal NEVER unregisters. Severity ordering: Informational < Advisory < Blocking.

Design: sutra/223 implementation_plan. Tests: rules parsing (both flag forms), registry monotonicity (floor never lowers, re-registration idempotent), flag-removal-keeps-row.
